title: Paddle Board Picnics Lessons Rentals and Outdoor Adventures
includes: Paddle Boards, PFD, Paddles, Dry Bags, Phone Case, Map of Harbor
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the beautiful fayette County with Winged not Wired Watersports, where outdoor fun awaits. Enjoy Stand-up Paddle Boarding (SUP) at sunset with rental options perfect for families, including junior boards for kids and tandem paddles for little ones. Take lessons from seasoned instructors in windsurfing or try your hand at Wing-Suping on breezy days. Gather your crew for a Paddle Board Picnic in a tranquil lagoon, or enjoy a day of biking and hiking in stunning natural settings. And yes, your furry friends can join the adventure too on our tandem SUP boards, ensuring everyone has a blast outside.
